question: How many trillion dollar companies will there be on December 18, 2026?

calls.reasoning: CompaniesMarketCap shows 15 companies above $1T on Nov 20, 2026 (intraday). 11 are well clear; Berkshire ($1.222T) and Lilly ($1.211T) are about 17% clear; Anthropic ($1.216T, listed Nov 19 and volatile) has about a 75% chance of staying above; Walmart ($1.026T, about 2.5% above, closed near $1.00T Nov 19) about 62%; Samsung ($900B, needs about +11%) about 20%; JPM/AMD/MU add a little upside. A roughly independent combination gives 15 ≈ 46%, 14 ≈ 37%; I widened the tails because the swing names move together in an AI-led selloff (S&P down about 2% on each of the last two days). No matching human prediction market found.
